guide_line: Decide whether a compound is ionic or molecular, then write the formula that cancels the charges.
steps: A metal with a nonmetal makes an ionic compound. Two nonmetals make a molecular compound.
In an ionic formula the positive ion is written first. The subscripts are the smallest whole numbers that make the charges add to zero.
Group 1 ions are 1+. Group 2 ions are 2+. Aluminum is Al3+. Group 16 ions are 2-. Group 17 ions are 1-.
Cross the charge numbers to get the subscripts. Ca2+ and N3- make Ca3N2. A subscript of 1 is left off.
Keep parentheses around a polyatomic ion when its subscript is greater than 1. Ammonium sulfate is (NH4)2SO4.

worked_example.q: Write the formula of the compound formed by sodium and chlorine. Use no spaces.
steps: Sodium is Na+ and chlorine is Cl-.
The charges already add to zero, so the formula is NaCl.

similar_problem.q: Write the formula of the compound formed by magnesium and oxygen. Use no spaces.
similar_problem.hint: Magnesium is 2+ and oxygen is 2-. The charges already match, so both subscripts drop off.

problems.q: Is the compound of magnesium and chlorine ionic or molecular? Type one word.
problems.why: Magnesium is a metal and chlorine is a nonmetal, so the compound is ionic.
hints: Look for a metal paired with a nonmetal. Magnesium is the metal.

problems.q: Is CO2 ionic or molecular? Type one word.
problems.why: Carbon and oxygen are both nonmetals, so CO2 is molecular.
hints: Both elements in CO2 sit on the nonmetal side of the staircase.

problems.q: Is KBr ionic or molecular? Type one word.
problems.why: Potassium is a metal and bromine is a nonmetal, so KBr is ionic.
hints: Potassium is in group 1. A group 1 element with a halogen is ionic.

problems.q: Write the formula of the compound formed by magnesium and chlorine. Use no spaces.
problems.why: Mg is 2+ and Cl is 1-. Two chloride ions balance one magnesium ion: MgCl2.
hints: Magnesium loses two electrons and each chlorine gains one. Cross the 2 onto chlorine.

problems.q: Write the formula of the compound formed by aluminum and oxygen. Use no spaces.
problems.why: Al is 3+ and O is 2-. Crossing charges gives Al2O3.
hints: Aluminum is 3+ and oxygen is 2-. The subscripts are the opposite charges, reduced if needed.

problems.q: Write the formula of the compound formed by calcium and nitrogen. Use no spaces.
problems.why: Ca is 2+ and N is 3-. Crossing charges gives Ca3N2.
hints: Calcium is 2+ and nitride is 3-. Cross 3 onto calcium and 2 onto nitrogen.

problems.q: Write the formula of the compound formed by sodium and oxygen. Use no spaces.
problems.why: Na is 1+ and O is 2-. Two sodium ions balance one oxide ion: Na2O.
hints: Oxygen is 2- and sodium is 1+. The subscript 2 goes on sodium.

problems.q: Write the formula of the compound of Fe3+ and O2-. Use no spaces.
problems.why: The charges 3+ and 2- cross to Fe2O3.
hints: Use the given charges, 3+ and 2-. Cross them and do not reduce 2 and 3.

problems.q: Write the formula of ammonium sulfate. Ammonium is NH4+ and sulfate is SO4 2-. Use no spaces, and use parentheses when a subscript belongs to a whole ion.
problems.why: Two NH4+ ions balance one SO4 2-, so the formula is (NH4)2SO4.
hints: Sulfate is 2- and ammonium is 1+. Put parentheses around NH4 because its subscript is greater than 1.

problems.q: What is the formula mass of H2SO4? Use H = 1.008, S = 32.06, and O = 15.999 g/mol. Type the number and the unit g/mol.
hints: Add two hydrogens, one sulfur, and four oxygens using the masses given in the question.

problems.q: Name the compound Al2O3. Type the full name in lowercase words.
problems.why: Aluminum is the metal and oxygen becomes oxide. The name is aluminum oxide.
hints: Name the metal first. Change the nonmetal ending to -ide. Subscripts are not spoken as prefixes here.

problems.q: Is N2O5 ionic or molecular? Type one word.
problems.why: Nitrogen and oxygen are both nonmetals, so N2O5 is molecular.
hints: There is no metal in N2O5. Two nonmetals make a molecular compound.

problems.q: What is the usual charge of an aluminum ion? Type it like 3+ or 2-.
problems.why: Aluminum is in group 13 and loses three valence electrons. The ion is Al3+, written 3+.
hints: Group 13 metals lose three electrons. The charge is positive.

problems.q: Write the formula of calcium bromide. Use no spaces.
problems.why: Ca is 2+ and Br is 1-. The formula is CaBr2.
hints: Calcium is 2+ and each bromide is 1-. The subscript 2 belongs on bromine.
